description: Update garden objects (one or more) in one call: position, size, rotation, label, or swap the product with productId or productQuery (plants and buildings adopt the new catalog size; ground shapes keep their shape and swap texture only). A generic plant shape resizes (width, height, tall) within its form's range and keeps its form; it becomes a species with swap_shapes. Returns `ids` and `issues`.

objects.description: Array of update specs, each must include 'id'

elevation.description: New elevation in meters — ground surfaces only; architecture keeps its catalog height

notes.description: A shape: the notes for its species

productId.description: New product ID — swaps the product. Plants/buildings adopt new catalog dimensions; ground shapes keep shape and swap texture only.

productQuery.description: Product name search — resolved to productId. Use this OR productId.

tall.description: A shape: how tall it grows, m (a new width alone keeps a crown's proportions; sizes stay within the form's range)

name: update_objects
